recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future MedicationDispense example issues should target specific active List entries or example XML files rather than reopening this broad 2015May cleanup request.
issue_request: FHIR-8069 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request for the 2015May MedicationDispense examples page, asking to fix examples whose narrative did not explain what each example was intended to show and whose links were reported broken.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly names FHIR-8069, but the July 2016 commit 3c1ac7d63d01851916dacaeae5ae7e2d35c51255, after the April 2016 persuasive vote, broadly updated Pharmacy examples by replacing the small MedicationDispense example set with many detailed examples and an explanatory examples header. A May 2017 follow-up corrected MedicationDispense example labels, and the January 2021 source rework moved the active example index into list-MedicationDispense-examples.xml.
additional_context: MedicationDispense remains an active resource in source/fhir.ini. The current active examples List contains 34 MedicationDispense entries with non-empty descriptions and matching source XML files, and the current CI page renders them as generated example rows with HTML, XML, JSON, and Turtle links. The older examples header file remains in source history, but current CI no longer uses it as the authoritative example index.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No current build-scope source edit is needed because the active examples List and generated examples page already provide detailed descriptions and generated links.

related_jiras.note: A later commit updated the same active MedicationDispense examples List for a declined-dispense use case; it was useful history context but not part of the FHIR-8069 decision.
